title: Workspace health report
description: One entry per check the routine ran against the Antasphere workspace: steward status, steward sync, steward secrets status, team tools outdated, steward doctor. A check the run could not perform is reported as failed with its detail, never left out.

name.description: The command as run: steward status, steward sync, steward secrets status, team tools outdated, steward doctor.

verdict.description: ok: nothing to do; fixed: a safe fix was applied; attention: something is left for the person; failed: the check could not run.

detail.description: One or two sentences: what the check found, in plain words.

fixed.description: The safe fixes applied, one line each (a checkout fast-forwarded, a clone made, a secret pulled, a tool updated).

proposed.description: What the person should do by hand, one line each, with the command when there is one.

machine.description: The machine's hostname, so a report read later says where it ran.
